D1.strategy: Explicit answer formatting and multi-app identity tracking

D2.strategy: Direct targeted API tool invocations without exploratory trial calls

D4.strategy: Step-budgeted execution: plan sequence upfront, batch queries, mutate early

D5.strategy: Sliding window of 30 turns to retain execution context

D6.strategy: Strict schema conformance: raw numeric values without currency symbols

distilled_patterns.description: Exploratory probing, sequential record inspection, and redundant schema checks exhaust the step budget before performing required mutations.
distilled_patterns.effect: Causes 0.0 reward across complex multi-step tasks; resolved by planning upfront, filtering queries, and executing mutations immediately once targets are found.

distilled_patterns.description: Final answers fail validation when scalar outputs include unexpected currency symbols (e.g. '$') or prose wrappers instead of clean numeric values.
distilled_patterns.effect: Evaluator rejects answers despite correct underlying computation; resolved by stripping symbols and outputting raw values.
